quote: Automatically correcting errors and editing spoken into written language would significantly benefit downstream tasks.

We have presented a dataset CS2W, which is the first open‑source Chinese spoken‑to‑written conversion dataset... We conducted benchmark evaluation experiments on CS2W to evaluate the performance of cutting‑edge large language models (LLMs) on Chinese spoken‑to‑written style conversion... To assess the impact of spoken‑to‑written language conversion on downstream tasks, we employed Chinese‑to‑English machine translation as a representative task.
Spoken-to-written style conversion can be formulated as a monolingual translation task, mapping from a spoken style text to a normalized written style text.
outputs: written‑style normalized Chinese sentences (and downstream MT translations)
normalized written style texts from spoken style inputs
